result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also meets the lower fallback limits. The unchanged bankruptcy provision remains effective and no contradiction is introduced. However, the redline is not strictly minimal because it adds requirements beyond the stated position, including maintenance at Commerce One's own expense and a cyber-insurance trigger for processing “Corio” data in addition to Customer Data. Drafting quality is reduced by the potentially ambiguous distinction between “Corio” data and “Customer data” and the failure to use the specified “cyber/privacy” terminology expressly.
